title: YingLan: A Multimodal Ocean Foundation Model for Unified Representation Learning from Heterogeneous Observations
abstract: arXiv:2610.29313v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal ocean modeling remains challenging due to substantial heterogeneity in data structures, physical semantics, and spatiotemporal characteristics across satellite imagery, gridded oceanographic fields, and buoy observations. Existing approaches largely focus on task-specific ocean modeling, while learning transferable representations from heterogeneous observations remains an open problem. To address this challenge, we propose YingLan, a multimodal ocean foundation model that integrates physics-attribute-conditioned dynamic encoding, Spatiotemporal Increment Coupling (STIC), and ocean-state evolution-aware pretraining. Specifically, the dynamic encoding mechanism generates adaptive input projections conditioned on physical semantics and observation characteristics, enabling flexible representation of heterogeneous ocean variables. translated_title: YingLan：面向异构观测统一表示学习的多模态海洋基础模型
translated_abstract: 多模态海洋建模仍然极具挑战性，其原因在于卫星影像、网格化海洋场与浮标观测在数据结构、物理语义和时空特性上存在显著的异构性。现有方法大多聚焦于特定任务的海洋建模，而从异构观测中学习可迁移的表示仍是一个悬而未决的问题。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 YingLan——一种多模态海洋基础模型，它集成了物理属性条件化动态编码、时空增量耦合以及面向海洋状态演化的预训练。具体而言，动态编码机制依据物理语义与观测特性生成自适应的输入投影，从而能够灵活地表征异构海洋变量；STIC 通过潜在时间特征的跨尺度交互来建模多尺度时空依赖关系……
tldr: 提出了多模态海洋基础模型 YingLan，通过物理属性条件化动态编码、时空增量耦合（STIC）与海洋状态演化感知预训练，实现了对卫星影像、网格化海洋场和浮标观测等异构数据的统一可迁移表示学习。
en_tdlr: YingLan is a multimodal ocean foundation model that learns unified, transferable representations from heterogeneous ocean observations (satellite imagery, gridded fields, and buoy data) through physics-attribute-conditioned dynamic encoding, Spatiotemporal Increment Coupling (STIC), and ocean-state evolution-aware pretraining.
